sections.title: Movers in Brentwood, CA, for Canyon Homes and Condos
sections.content: Brentwood asks a moving crew to change tactics from one block to the next. North of Sunset Boulevard, streets climb into Mandeville and Kenter canyons; between Sunset and San Vicente, Brentwood Park curves around landscaped traffic circles; and most apartments and condos sit between San Vicente and Wilshire or along Barrington Avenue. We plan every job around the actual address, the gate and the pieces you care about most. What every Brentwood booking includes: A clear hourly rate: From $119/hr for 2 movers and a truck Monday–Thursday at the cash rate, $135/hr Friday–Sunday. Stairs, long carries and multiple stops are covered by the hourly rate. Paperwork in order: CPUC licensed, USDOT 3398018, MC 1153871 and CAL-T0192140, with full liability coverage and workers' compensation. Reviewed by customers: 4.9 on Google from 1,007 reviews. Start with a free estimate and tell us about the street, the gate and anything fragile.

sections.title: White Glove Moving for Art, Antiques and Fine Furniture
sections.content: Brentwood is home to the Getty Center, and your own collection deserves the same patience on moving day, whether it is one framed canvas or a house full of antiques. Our white glove movers bring that care to every job, from a Period Revival house in Brentwood Park to a mid-century modern home in Crestwood Hills. Comparing Brentwood luxury movers? Ask each one exactly how they wrap a framed painting; here is our answer. How our white glove handling works: Wrapped item by item: Blankets, shrink wrap and tape go on every piece, framed art and mirrors get extra padding, and hanging clothes travel in wardrobe boxes. Taken apart, rebuilt: Beds, dining tables and oversized furniture are disassembled for the trip and reassembled in the new rooms, and wall-mounted TVs come down before loading. Placed where it belongs: The crew sets each piece where you point and helps you unpack, so the house works on the first night. Want the rest of the house boxed too? Add packing services and the crew packs books, kitchenware and closets before the truck is loaded.

sections.title: Local Moves Around Brentwood and Across LA
sections.content: Whether you need local movers in Brentwood, CA, for a move across the Westside or a long-distance move out of state, the plan starts with your street. North of Sunset, the canyon roads include Mandeville Canyon Road, a long dead-end road up the canyon, while south of Sunset the neighborhood is mostly flat. On San Vicente Boulevard, a wide median planted with coral trees splits the traffic, so we confirm which side of the boulevard the truck should use before move day. Covered by the hourly rate: Stairs, carries, stops: Flights of stairs, long walks from the curb and multiple stops are included, not added as surcharges. Gates and buildings: Tell us if you live in a gated enclave such as Brentwood Circle, or in a condo that books elevator time for moves, and we schedule the arrival around it. Same-day openings: Same-day moves are possible when a crew is free. Call 909-443-0004, Monday – Sunday, 8AM – 6PM. On longer hourly moves, Double Drive Time applies under CPUC rules; ask us whether it affects your route when you book.

sections.title: Long-Distance Movers From Brentwood, Los Angeles
sections.content: Heading to another state? From Brentwood, I-405 on the neighborhood's eastern edge climbs the Sepulveda Pass past the Getty Center toward I-5, or runs south to I-10 for routes east. Furniture is wrapped and padded before it is loaded, then delivered and reassembled at the new home. Built for the long haul: Packed for the distance: Blankets and shrink wrap on every piece of furniture, with full packing available for the rest of the house. Storage if dates slip: If the closing on your next home runs late, your belongings can wait in storage until you are ready for delivery. Interstate authority: USDOT 3398018 and MC 1153871, backed by full liability coverage and workers' compensation. Staying in the Los Angeles area instead? Our local moving service is billed by the hour, and we can quote it next to a long-distance option in the same call.

sections.title: Office Moves in Brentwood
sections.content: Moving a practice or office on the Wilshire corridor or near Brentwood Village at Sunset and Barrington? Our commercial movers pack files, take down and rebuild workstations, and can book weekend dates so weekday business keeps running.

faq.question: Can you move us into a gated community like Brentwood Circle?
faq.answer: Yes. Brentwood Circle is gated, and Brentwood Country Estates in lower Mandeville Canyon is guard-gated, so send us the gate instructions and any HOA requirements for movers when you book. We set the arrival window around them so the truck is not left waiting at the entrance.

faq.question: What does an hour of white-glove crew time cost in Brentwood?
faq.answer: Rates start at $119/hr for 2 movers and a truck Monday–Thursday at the cash rate, and $135/hr Friday–Sunday. There is a $30 gas fee, and the $50 deposit is applied toward your total. Stairs, long carries and multiple stops are included; a piano adds $200 and any item heavier than 300 lbs adds $150.

faq.question: Do you offer white glove service for art and antiques in Brentwood?
faq.answer: Yes. Our white glove service covers blanket and shrink-wrap protection, furniture disassembly and reassembly, TV unmounting, placement and unpacking help. List your most valuable or oversized pieces when you book so we can plan the load around them.

faq.question: Can you move a condo on San Vicente or Wilshire?
faq.answer: Yes. Most of Brentwood's apartments and condos sit between San Vicente and Wilshire or along Barrington Avenue, and our apartment movers work around building schedules. If your building reserves the elevator or loading area for moves, book the slot and send us the time window.

faq.question: Is this Brentwood in Los Angeles or in Contra Costa County?
faq.answer: This page covers Brentwood on the Westside of Los Angeles, bounded by I-405 on the east and Santa Monica on the southwest. There is also a city of Brentwood in Contra Costa County, in the East Bay. A move between the two is a long-distance move, and we quote it like any other.
